notes.title: Hotfix v1.141
notes.notes:
Isle Of Jura Version 1.141


Fixed issues with fishing in waterfalls

Improved camera collision while fishing

notes.title: Update v1.14
notes.notes:
Isle Of Jura Version 1.14


Hi everyone! In this update I've made the much requested changes to the camera system, to allow players to have control of the camera. There are some lingering issues with camera collision, but I will continue to work on fixes when I can.



Thanks,



E.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.132
notes.notes:
Isle Of Jura Version 1.132


 Fixed various UI bugs
 Added a full screen / window toggle in the options panel
 Fixed volume settings not saving properly

notes.title: Hotfix v1.131
notes.notes:
Isle Of Jura Version 1.131


 Updated Linux version to v1.131
 Made fly fishing initial timing more forgiving
 Disabled controller / mouse and keyboard lock (both control schemes now work simultaneously)

notes.title: Update v1.13
notes.notes:
Isle Of Jura Version 1.13


 Reduced duration of fish display animation
 Reduced overall fly fishing difficulty
 Fixed being able to fish in rivers with the incorrect rod type
 Made adjustments to island geometry and player hitbox to prevent players getting stuck
 Added autosaving when the player catches a fish
 Added an "unstuck" button in the options menu (use this if you get yourself trapped)
 Fixed various bugs that occurred when the player has a full inventory
 Fixed NPCs sometimes remaining in their talk animation after dialogue has finished

notes.title: New update coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First off, thanks to all the new players we've had after the free weekend. It's great to see your feedback and bug reports in the steam discussions!

Due to full time work, I haven't been able to work on the game. Now that I have more free time, I'm working on a new update to fix existing bugs and add some user experience improvements.

For any bugs you encounter, or any suggestions you have for the game, please send details of these to emgamesdev@gmail.com - i'll be sure to read through them all and do what I can.

Trading cards / badges / profile backgrounds will also be here soon, pending approval from Steam.

Thanks again for playing!

E.

notes.title: Eternal Edge + Release Coming Soon!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Isle of Jura Update v1.06 Patch
notes.notes:
Isle of Jura Update Changelog

Hi everyone! There's been a few bug fixes pushed in the latest updates. Please see the changelog below.

notes.title: Isle of Jura Update v1.05 Patch
notes.notes:
Isle of Jura Update Changelog

Hi everyone! We noticed a few bugs that we wanted to fix before release. Below is the changelog for the latest update.

Bug Fixes

 fixed controller inventory slot highlights not resetting in shops

Enjoy the update! Have questions? Talk with the dev and Sedoc team on Discord!

notes.title: Isle of Jura Update v1.04 + Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello Villagers! 

We are excited to share that the game will be released this Friday, Feb. 11th! We can't wait to see what you all catch in Isle of Jura. We've just uploaded a new build with bug fixes and QOL updates. 

See you on launch day!


Changelog

For anyone that currently has early access of the game we have made a few bug fixes and quality of life improvements. Please view the changelog below!

Game Updates

 Made fly fishing slightly easier


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the dialogue would loop when talking to the ferryman with a controller. 
 Fixed incorrect menu behaviour on the options tab when using a controller.
